description: Keeps the shared package stores and store-backed installs intact. Blocks `bun pm cache rm`, deleting/moving ~/.bun/install/cache (or an ancestor, or anything inside it), `uv cache clean` / `uv cache prune --all|--ci` and deleting ~/.cache/uv, creating a symlink named node_modules (`ln -s`/`ln -sfn` — bun install writes through it into the other checkout), and npm/pnpm/yarn install-class verbs (install, ci, add, update, uninstall/remove, prune; bare `yarn`) where the nearest lockfile is bun.lock/bun.lockb (npm-only subprojects with package-lock.json and global installs stay allowed), and installing or starting a banned container VM runtime (`colima start`, `limactl start`, `brew install colima|lima|podman|orbstack|docker-desktop`, `nix run nixpkgs#colima`, `open -a Docker`), and `lefthook install`/`husky`/`simple-git-hooks` while core.hooksPath points outside the repo (they would overwrite rig's global pre-commit composer). Each block names the command to run instead (`bun install --frozen-lockfile`, `rig worktree gc`, Apple `container`/`mocker`, the native fake-gcs-server backend). No self-service bypass.
